note: Chuỗi tìm kiếm Boolean đề xuất, CHỜ Ben duyệt (Gate 1). Xem docs/literature-review/harvest/PROTOCOL.md. oa_query dùng cho OpenAlex (title_and_abstract.search, hỗ trợ AND, OR, NOT, cụm trong dấu nháy); s2_query là chuỗi từ khóa thường cho Semantic Scholar (không hỗ trợ Boolean ở endpoint này).

topics.title: Quản lý dữ liệu nghiên cứu y sinh
topics.oa_query: ("research data management") AND (biomedical OR clinical OR health)

topics.title: Kế hoạch quản lý và chia sẻ dữ liệu (DMP, DMSP)
topics.oa_query: ("data management plan" OR "data management and sharing") AND (funder OR policy OR NIH OR biomedical)
topics.s2_query: data management plan funder policy data sharing biomedical

topics.title: Quản trị dữ liệu và Data Steward
topics.oa_query: ("data stewardship" OR "data steward" OR "data governance") AND (health OR clinical OR biomedical OR research)
topics.s2_query: data stewardship data governance health research

topics.title: Khủng hoảng tái lập trong nghiên cứu y sinh
topics.oa_query: (reproducibility OR replicability) AND (crisis OR preclinical OR biomedical)

topics.title: Toàn vẹn dữ liệu, ALCOA+ và giám sát theo rủi ro
topics.oa_query: ("data integrity" OR ALCOA OR "risk-based monitoring" OR "risk based monitoring") AND ("clinical trial" OR "clinical research")
topics.s2_query: clinical trial data integrity ALCOA risk-based monitoring

topics.title: Thu thập dữ liệu điện tử (EDC, REDCap)
topics.oa_query: (REDCap OR "electronic data capture") AND (clinical OR research)
topics.s2_query: electronic data capture REDCap clinical research

topics.title: Chuẩn dữ liệu y tế: CDISC, FHIR, OMOP
topics.oa_query: (CDISC OR FHIR OR OMOP) AND (interoperability OR standard OR "common data model")
topics.s2_query: CDISC FHIR OMOP common data model interoperability clinical research

topics.title: Đánh giá chất lượng dữ liệu y tế
topics.oa_query: "data quality" AND ("electronic health record" OR EHR OR clinical) AND (assessment OR framework)
topics.s2_query: data quality assessment electronic health records framework

topics.title: Dữ liệu khuyết và gán đa bội
topics.oa_query: ("missing data" OR "multiple imputation") AND (clinical OR trial OR "electronic health")
topics.s2_query: missing data multiple imputation clinical research

topics.title: Khử định danh và rủi ro tái định danh
topics.oa_query: (deidentification OR "de-identification" OR "re-identification" OR "k-anonymity") AND (health OR clinical OR patient)
topics.s2_query: de-identification health data re-identification risk k-anonymity

topics.title: Môi trường nghiên cứu tin cậy và Five Safes
topics.oa_query: ("trusted research environment" OR "secure data environment" OR "five safes" OR "data safe haven") AND (health OR research)
topics.s2_query: trusted research environment five safes health data access

topics.title: Bảo vệ dữ liệu cá nhân trong nghiên cứu y sinh (khái quát)
topics.oa_query: ("personal data protection" OR "data protection" OR GDPR) AND (health OR clinical OR "medical research")
topics.s2_query: data protection law health research GDPR

topics.title: Bảo vệ dữ liệu và hồ sơ y tế ở Việt Nam (kiểm tra độ phủ)
topics.oa_query: Vietnam AND ("personal data" OR "data protection" OR "electronic medical record" OR "health data")
topics.s2_query: Vietnam personal data protection electronic medical records

topics.title: Đồng ý, đạo đức và chia sẻ dữ liệu y sinh
topics.oa_query: "data sharing" AND (consent OR ethics OR participants) AND (biomedical OR clinical OR health)
topics.s2_query: data sharing consent ethics biomedical research participants

topics.title: Nguyên tắc FAIR và FAIR hóa
topics.oa_query: ("FAIR principles" OR FAIRification OR "FAIR data") AND (health OR biomedical OR "life sciences")
topics.s2_query: FAIR data principles implementation FAIRification life sciences

topics.title: Dữ liệu sẵn sàng cho AI trong y sinh
topics.oa_query: ("AI-ready" OR "AI-readiness" OR "datasheets for datasets" OR "data readiness") AND (biomedical OR health OR clinical)
topics.s2_query: AI-ready datasets biomedical data documentation datasheets

topics.title: Tái lập tính toán và phần mềm nghiên cứu
topics.oa_query: ("computational reproducibility" OR "reproducible research" OR "research software" OR "reproducible workflow") AND (biomedical OR bioinformatics OR clinical OR health)
topics.s2_query: computational reproducibility research software workflow biomedical
